name: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd
title: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd - 544058 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 5% to INR125.3 cr with EBITDA margin down to 21.2% and PAT 1.8%, as marketing rose to 8.5% of revenue; management gave no numeric growth visibility beyond the next few quarters.

triggers.label: Demand moderated mid-May
triggers.quote: healthy consumer interest through April and part of May which moderated towards the mid of May

triggers.label: No growth numbers for 2 years
triggers.quote: for the next 2-odd years, it's going to be very difficult for us to say what exactly the numbers will pan out

triggers.label: Store count net down 2 (5 open, 7 closed)
triggers.quote: we opened 5 new stores across leading malls and high streets while closing 7 underperforming stores, taking our total store count to 427

triggers.label: Inventory days 74; reduction only 'endeavour'
triggers.quote: there should be some reduction in the inventory days. That is always the endeavour to

guidance.quote: in line with our full year guidance of 8% to 10% through FY27
we are looking to increase the same-store revenue in the mid-single-digit numbers

red_flags.label: Revenue growth below ad spend growth; EBITDA down ~14%
red_flags.quote: primarily due to higher investments in advertising, brand building and retail transformation

red_flags.label: No numeric visibility on growth for 2 years
red_flags.quote: I'm unable to extrapolate and give any numbers as to what is the growth numbers that we will achieve

evasions.quote: for the next couple of years, I'm unable to extrapolate and give any numbers

evasions.topic: Revenue growth exceeding ad spend within 1 year
evasions.quote: No. I'm unable to say that today, Nilesh.
How you want to call it survival mode or whatever you want to call it, I really don't know.
